account.label: Account
account.description: Your details, email address and password.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.description: GANIS theme and text size, applied to all your projects.

developer.label: Developer
developer.description: Create your own packages. To start with: themes, usable right away on this device.

saving.label: Saving
saving.description: Automatic or manual saving of your changes, on this device.

info.title: Account details
info.description: This information is stored locally, on this device.

email.title: Email address
email.description: Optional, used only as a local contact. Leave the field empty to remove it.
email.label: Email address
email.failed: Unable to change the email address.

password.title: Password
password.description: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit. Your projects stay accessible with the new password.

recovery.title: Recovery key
recovery.description: It lets you choose a new password if you forget yours, without losing your projects. If you lost it, or someone else may have seen it, create a new one: the old one will stop working.
recovery.failed: Could not create a new key.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.description: Permanently erases your account, your private projects (trash included) and all their data. Public projects remain.
delete.exportFirst: Export the projects you want to keep as .ganix first: nothing can be recovered after deletion.
delete.understand: I understand that my account and private projects will be permanently deleted.

profile.title: Author profile
profile.description: Optional. This information introduces you as an author; it is encrypted and stays on this device.
profile.penNamePlaceholder: E.g. the name on your books

emailRecovery.title: Email recovery
emailRecovery.description: If you forget your password, a code sent to this address will let you choose a new one without losing your projects. The server only keeps a secret that is useless without this computer. Note: anyone with access to this mailbox and this computer could open your account.
emailRecovery.statusOn: On: a code sent by email lets you choose a new password.
emailRecovery.statusOff: Off: without your password, your private projects could not be recovered.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose the look of the interface.

light.label: Light
light.description: Light background, comfortable during the day.

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Dark background, easy on the eyes at night.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: Makes the whole interface larger or smaller.

preview.title: Preview
preview.text: Inspiration comes while writing: every project starts with a first sentence.

note.title: Saved on this device
note.text: These preferences never change the content of your projects.

colorTheme.title: Color theme
colorTheme.description: Palette used in both light and dark modes.

panelImage.title: Middle panel images
panelImage.description: Size of the images in the character, location, object, fauna and flora lists. The same setting applies to all of them.

panelMenu.title: Right-click menu in the middle panel
panelMenu.description: Right-clicking a character, a location, an item, a note… offers Open, Rename, Add inside, Duplicate and Delete.
panelMenu.on: On: right-clicking opens the element's menu.
panelMenu.off: Off: right-clicking does nothing; left-clicking still opens the sheet.

previewTabs.title: Preview tabs
previewTabs.description: Like VS Code: a single click on an item in the middle panel opens it in a temporary tab (italic title), replaced by the next item opened the same way. Double-clicking the item or the tab, editing it or pinning it keeps it open.
previewTabs.toggle: Open as a preview on single click
previewTabs.on: On: a click opens a preview, a double-click keeps the tab.
previewTabs.off: Off: every click opens a new tab.

profileFrame.title: Profile photo frame
profileFrame.description: A frame surrounds the photo of characters, places, items and other sheets, on the sheet and in lists. White by default, like a photo print.
profileFrame.on: On: every profile photo has a frame.
profileFrame.off: Off: photos are shown without a frame.
profileFrame.reset: Back to the default white frame

moduleOrder.title: Module order
moduleOrder.description: The order of the modules in the left bar, on this device. A module a project doesn't have (project type, disabled world module) keeps its place when it shows up. Search always stays last.
moduleOrder.previousHint: Details, Characters, Locations and the world modules first, then Structure, Plot, the project type module and Notes.

sheetPreview.title: Profile preview
sheetPreview.description: The button on the right of the tab bar (an open book, then a pencil) switches a profile (character, location, object, fauna and flora, faction, people, magic) to its preview: the essentials, read-only. A second click brings back the form. By default, this choice applies to every profile.
sheetPreview.on: On: only the profile shown switches to its preview (or back to the form).
sheetPreview.off: Off: switching to the preview, or back to the form, applies to every profile.

become.title: Become a developer
become.description: Developer mode adds creation tools to your account.

perks.create: Create theme plugins: light and dark colors, corner radius, live preview.
perks.direct: Your creations work right away, with no download or installation.
perks.share: Later: publish and share your packages with the community.

become.note: Your projects and preferences stay the same.
become.confirmText: Your account “{{username}}” will get the Developer role and access to package creation tools.

active.title: Developer mode is on
active.description: Your account has access to package creation tools.
active.roleAdmin: As an administrator, you already have every development tool.

tools.title: Create a plugin
tools.description: Choose the type of package to create.

theme.title: Theme plugin
theme.description: Light and dark mode colors, corner radius. Usable right away.

leave.title: Leave developer mode
leave.description: Your account goes back to being a regular user account.
leave.details: Creation tools and your themes will no longer be shown. Your themes aren't deleted: they'll come back if you turn developer mode on again.
leave.confirmText: Creation tools will be hidden. If one of your themes is in use, GANIS will switch back to the default theme. You can turn developer mode back on at any time.

autoSave.title: Auto save
autoSave.description: Choose whether GANIS saves your changes on its own or you save them yourself.
autoSave.on_one: On: saves {{count}} second after your last change.
autoSave.on_other: On: saves {{count}} seconds after your last change.
autoSave.off: Off: you save with the “Save” button.

delay.title: Delay before saving
delay.description: Time without a new change before GANIS saves.

note.title: Spotting unsaved work
note.dot: A dot instead of the close button marks an unsaved tab.
note.ask: Before closing such a tab, leaving the page or closing GANIS, you're asked whether to save, not save, or cancel.

lock.settingDescription: After this period without activity, GANIS erases your account key from memory and asks for your password to resume. Your tabs and unsaved input stay in place. Setting for this computer only.
lock.title: GANIS is locked
lock.description: Enter the password for {{name}} to resume.
